main_body: A tall palm-like tree: a thin brown trunk about 4px wide (rows 18-54) under a dark green frond canopy (rows 0-22) with a light green highlight patch at the top.
top_band: none. The canopy is a foliage mass with a light green highlight patch at rows 1-6, not a horizontal top surface. The trunk is a vertical column with a thin dark base at rows 53-54.
evidence: Organic tree drawn in side view: radiating fronds and a straight trunk, with no top surface and front face structure. Reading the middle column gives dark green fronds and then a flat brown trunk down to a dark base. There is no top band, no front edge line and no eave shadow. The trunk is a plain vertical cylinder with only a thin base. For an organic object this reads as a front elevation, so it fails under the strict rule.

style.evidence: The canopy has about 4 greens plus a light highlight patch, and the leaf blocks are blocky with little clumping, much sparser than the reference canopies, which have many greens, leaf clumps and highlights. The trunk is a 4px-wide brown strip with only a few darker dots and one light edge, so it is a nearly flat fill over about 36 rows. The dark outline under the fronds is a near-black tint with some dark green. The trunk is thin and long, with far fewer colours per tile than the reference trees. It would look thinner and flatter next to the reference.
